summary: The morning after a loss, the children comfort the candidate in their own ways.
realLife: The day after Michelle Nunn lost the 2014 Georgia Senate race, her nine-year-old daughter told her she was sorry she lost, and her eleven-year-old son proposed shopping and asked for a phone.
gates: An election result is on record as lost.
inGame: race-lost and family-loss after a lost race can carry it.

turns.what: The children are upset and ask why.
One child comforts, the other asks about the money.
